digest.component_or_area: route reconciler differ/apply core via Backend port
propositions: Vendor mapper entrypoints (_map_local_to_jira_fields, _map_jira_to_local_fields) must be routed through Backend port dependency injection rather than direct module-level imports in differ/apply core

outbound_differ, inbound_differ, and apply_inbound must receive injected mapper parameters (Backend.outbound, Backend.inbound) and call map_local_to_remote() and map_remote_to_local() through the port
outbound_links._RELATION_TO_JIRA_LINK must be single-sourced in adapters/jira/jira_fields.py and imported from there by all callers
Non-mapping vendor helpers without Backend-port equivalents (outbound_fields helpers, reconcile_check lazy load) remain directly imported and are out of scope for this ticket
All reconciler unit and integration tests must pass and AST assertions must verify no direct vendor mapper imports in core differ modules
